chunks: From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever divorces his wife three times in one sitting while she is in her menstruation period, it is not valid. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) rejected the divorce of Abdullah ibn Umar when he divorced his wife three times while she was menstruating, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) annulled that divorce and said: 'Everything that contradicts the Book of Allah is returned to the Book of Allah,' and he said: 'There is no divorce except during the waiting period.' It is also possible that his saying 'it is not valid' means that it does not constitute three divorces, because we have explained that it is returned to one, and that which clarifies what we mentioned.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a triple divorce given while the wife is menstruating?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar clarifies the Shia position on triple divorce (talāq al-thalāth) pronounced simultaneously during menstruation, citing the precedent of Abd Allah ibn Umar where the Prophet Muhammad invalidated the act. It interprets the phrase 'not valid' as meaning the three divorces are reduced to one, emphasizing the principle that any ruling contradicting the Quran is returned to it. This reflects the scholarly consensus that the Prophet's action was not merely a temporary suspension but a definitive abrogation of the triple divorce in this context.
